subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: my lord he said to the caliph in a humble voice I know i have done wrong and must suffer for it but if i have the donkey i shall cause it a great deal of unnecessary suffering Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: “My lord,” he said to the Caliph in a humble voice ,” I know I have done wrong and must suffer for it. But if I have the donkey, I shall cause it a great deal of unnecessary suffering.” Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 179
